About TSX-MR

TSX-MR develops digital business-management solutions in Mauritania. Dukan ERP is one of its products.

Who we are

TSX-MR develops digital business-management solutions in Mauritania. Its work starts from the daily reality of local businesses: stock that moves quickly, money that passes through cash and mobile accounts, and teams that share the work across several stores.

What we build

Dukan ERP is one of our products. TSX-MR develops and operates it: we build the application, run the service and support the businesses that use it.

How we build

  • Every feature should make daily work faster or safer, with less typing.
  • Businesses decide who can see their records; the server enforces it.
  • Arabic, French and English are supported from the start.

Who operates TSX-MR

TSX-MR is a project and trading name. It is not a separately incorporated company: it is operated by Abdel Kerim Taleb Ould Sidi, an individual. The operator’s details are listed below.
